coast.title: The quiet coast
coast.description: A generated panorama of a sandy coast in late-afternoon light
coast.excerpt: Gentle ocean waves roll onto a broad sandy beach in warm late-afternoon light.
coast.note: Polar texture blur remains visible. Loop continuity and perceptual quality are still under evaluation.

waterfall.title: Where water falls
waterfall.description: A generated waterfall and forest pool surrounded by tall trees
waterfall.excerpt: A small broad waterfall cascades over a dark rock ledge into a clear forest pool beyond a flat gravel clearing.
waterfall.note: Repeated patterns and texture distortion remain near the sky and ground poles. The loop is an experimental sample.

campfire.title: After the daylight
campfire.description: A generated campfire at a forest campsite at blue hour
campfire.excerpt: A modest campfire burns inside a low circular ring of stones in a broad flat campsite at blue hour.
campfire.note: Ground-pole distortion and loop-boundary changes remain visible. The original generated audio is quiet.
